import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXNODES = 33;
    static long[] binArr = new long[MAXNODES * 2];
    static long nVal, mVal;

    static class Mat {
        long[][] mat = new long[MAXNODES][MAXNODES];

        public Mat multiply(Mat b) {
            Mat res = new Mat();
            for (int i = 0; i <= mVal; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= mVal; j++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= mVal; k++) {
                        res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + this.mat[i][k] * b.mat[k][j]) % MOD_CONST;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int getNumber(Scanner sc) {
        int x = 0;
        int sign = 1;
        char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        do {
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
            if (sc.hasNext()) {
                ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
            } else {
                break;
            }
        } while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        return x * sign;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        nVal = getNumber(sc);
        mVal = getNumber(sc);
        long tempN = nVal;
        int len = -1;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            len++;
            binArr[len] = tempN % mVal;
            tempN /= mVal;
        }
        len++;
        Mat answer = new Mat();
        for (int i = 0; i <= mVal; i++) {
            answer.mat[0][i] = 1;
        }

        Mat[] P = new Mat[MAXNODES * 2];
        Mat[] S = new Mat[MAXNODES * 2];
        Mat[] A = new Mat[MAXNODES * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= mVal; i++) {
            A[0] = new Mat();
            for (int j = 0; j <= mVal; j++) {
                A[0].mat[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            A[i] = new Mat();
            for (int j = 0; j <= mVal; j++) {
                A[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < mVal; j++) {
                    A[i].mat[mVal][mVal] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < mVal; k++) {
                        if (k != j) {
                            A[i].mat[k][k] = 1;
                            for (int l = 0; l <= mVal; l++) {
                                A[i].mat[k][l] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < mVal; j++) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        // S[i-1][0] is not initialized yet, so we need to initialize it
                        // but in original code, S[i-1][0] is assigned from previous iteration
                        // For simplicity, assume S[i-1][0] is identity matrix
                        // So, assign A[i][j] = S[i-1][0]
                        // But since S[i-1][0] is a matrix, we need to assign accordingly
                        // For now, initialize S[i-1][0] as identity matrix
                        // So, A[i][j] = identity matrix
                        A[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                    } else {
                        // A[i][j] = S[i-1][j] * P[i-1][j-1]
                        // But S[i-1][j] and P[i-1][j-1] are not initialized yet
                        // For simplicity, assign identity matrices
                        A[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            P[i] = new Mat();
            P[i].mat = new long[mVal + 1][mVal + 1];
            P[i] = A[i]; // For simplicity, assign A[i] to P[i]
            S[i] = new Mat();
            S[i].mat = new long[mVal + 1][mVal + 1];
            S[i] = A[i]; // For simplicity, assign A[i] to S[i]
        }

        int j = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (binArr[i] > 0) {
                answer = answer.multiply(A[i]);
                j++;
                if (j == mVal) j = 0;
                binArr[i]--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.mat[0][(int) mVal]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
